status: registered before running Phase 7 retrieval or examining its outcome labels
design: External transfer of frozen LoCoMo segmenters and the LoCoMo-development-only LSA model to the official cleaned LongMemEval-S corpus; no tuning on LongMemEval
training_source: Pinned LoCoMo three development conversations, turn text only, identical Phase 6 TF-IDF/SVD configuration; no LongMemEval text, labels or query in model fitting
eligibility: All non-abstention records (question_id not ending _abs) with at least one has_answer:true turn and structurally valid parallel session arrays; fail the run if any non-abstention record lacks labels or has inconsistent answer_session_ids; abstention records counted and excluded because no evidence target exists
adaptation: Within each LongMemEval question, session index becomes session_N and turn index becomes a unique turn ID; content alone becomes turn text. role, date, answer, answer_session_ids and has_answer are excluded from segmentation and ranking inputs. No cross-session segment spans.
frozen_method_contract: Fixed 128-word turn-aligned chunks; lexical event and semantic LSA with 64/128/160-word greedy chunks and 3-turn windows; full session; the identical LoCoMo BM25 ranking code and skip-if-over-budget whole-segment packing
primary_outcome: All has_answer:true turn IDs are present in the retrieved whole segments for a question under 1024 Unicode-regex word tokens
primary_comparison: semantic_lsa versus lexical event on exactly the same eligible questions
report: per-method counts and rates at all budgets
interpretation: External corpus but exploratory transfer: one question has its own constructed haystack, fillers may recur and question rows need not be independent. This is a turn-evidence retrieval comparison, not the official answer-generation score, human boundary quality or online memory test.
output_policy: Do not commit source datasets, question/answer/conversation text, gold turn IDs, model weights or embeddings. Preserve Phase 1-6 results byte-for-byte. Do not adjust method or eligibility after seeing outcome.
